title: Swarm fan-out
description: Default-off, BETA. Fans the research, pattern-mapping and code-review steps out to a swarm of read-only Haiku-class workers (gsd-swarm-worker), each answering a very small, file-scoped question with file:line evidence, and has the step's own agent synthesize their answers into the unchanged RESEARCH.md, PATTERNS.md or REVIEW.md. Declares the fanOutStrategy core's `loop fan-out-plan` calls; changes only how those steps are dispatched, never whether they run or what they write. Every worker claim the synthesizer keeps carries a swarm-anchor that `swarm verify-anchors` checks against the source, pruning unverified claims loudly. ADR-5273, issue #5273.

swarm.enabled.description: Master toggle for swarm fan-out (BETA). When false, research, pattern-mapping and code review dispatch their single agent exactly as before and no SWARM.json is written. ADR-5273.

swarm.roles.description: Comma-separated roles that fan out when swarm.enabled is true: any of researcher, pattern-mapper, code-reviewer. A role not listed dispatches its single agent quietly.

swarm.max_workers.description: Most worker units one role run may fan out to. Integer, at least 2, no upper bound (ADR-5273 Decision 2). Research and pattern-mapping decompose into as many small units as this allows; code review splits the change into units of about 60 changed lines and groups them above it. A run dispatches at most max_workers + 3 agents. Each worker answer is capped at 4 KiB, so the synthesizer reads at most max_workers x 4 KiB of answers.

swarm.max_concurrency.description: Most workers dispatched in one wave. Integer, at least 1. The effective concurrency is min(dispatch-capacity, swarm.max_concurrency, swarm.max_workers); below 2 the role runs single-agent with reason no_concurrency.
